text:
Predicates:
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThan(x, y) ::: x sold more than y copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
FIFA22 ::: the game FIFA 22.
LegendOfZelda ::: the game The Legend of Zelda.
Premises:
∀x (Game(x) ∧ MadeBy(x, y) → JapaneseCompany(y)) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThan(x, 1000000) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThan(LegendOfZelda, 1000000) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
∃y (MadeBy(FIFA22, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y)) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
